brief: A chat agent with one tool, web search, that remembers every answer with the date you asked, so you can come back and check whether it still holds.
criteria: Distinct from AI clichés (sparkles, brains, robots, purple gradients), clear at 16 px, works in one colour, says memory over time without a clock.

concepts.name: Strata
concepts.idea: Three layers of dated answers, newest shortest; the crimson dot is now.
rationale: Memory as layers in time, not a clock or a brain
One accent only: the dot marks the present answer
Built on a 20-unit grid: 40-unit bars, one radius, small-size cut for 16 px

recommendation: Strata: memory as layers in time, readable at 16 px, and the dot gives the UI one meaningful accent.
